page_topic_one_liner: AI agent sandbox — secure isolated execution for agent-generated code, shells, and browser actions via microVM boundaries, not production servers
differentiator_vs_generic: This is execution isolation and blast-radius containment — NOT generic cloud hosting, NOT LLM chat. Hero must be a visibly bounded sandbox/microVM with terminal code running inside a security perimeter while the host stays outside.
visual_anchors: HERO (~55% canvas): Firecracker-style microVM container — dashed mars-green security boundary box with terminal prompt + Python/shell code lines inside, small agent icon orchestrating from outside, host/production server icon clearly separated outside the boundary
Secondary: blast-radius visual — red impact burst fully contained inside sandbox, zero leakage to host layer
Tertiary: snapshot/checkpoint restore timeline — pause icon and rewind arrow on sandbox lifecycle strip
anti_patterns: Generic cloud server rack as hero
Docker whale logo or real vendor branding
Unbounded code editor without isolation boundary
Production laptop/server shown running untrusted agent code directly

Secondary: contained explosion/alert glyph trapped inside box boundary. Tertiary: snapshot checkpoint strip with pause/restore icons. Title block top-left only. Paper torn edges, halftone. NO LLM chat hero, NO generic datacenter, NO real E2B/AWS logos, NO readable command text, NO extra security label captions.
